# Kiwifruit

The kiwifruit is native to central and eastern China. The first recorded
description dates to the 12th century, during the Song dynasty.

Seeds were carried to New Zealand in 1904 by Mary Isabel Fraser, principal of
Wanganui Girls' College. Alexander Allison planted them in 1906 and the vines
first fruited in 1910. Commercial plantings began in the 1940s.

Vines are dioecious, so both male and female plants are needed. Commercial
orchards plant one male for every six to eight females.
